faqs.a: Open a piece in the shop at kobainkulture.pages.dev/shop.html, choose colour, size and quantity, and press Order on WhatsApp. The order is typed out for you; press send and the team confirms price, payment and delivery.
Everything is custom: the price depends on the design, fabric, embroidery and size. The team confirms the exact price on WhatsApp before you pay anything. Never guess or quote a price.

faqs.q: Can you make clothing for my kulture?
faqs.a: Yes. Kobain Kulture designs custom kultural wear for every kulture. Use the custom order page to describe your heritage, the occasion and the look you want.

faqs.q: Can I get a design in another colour?
faqs.a: Yes. Most designs can be made in other colourways, such as black, brown, cream or olive with gold.

faqs.q: Do you make pieces for women and children?
faqs.a: Yes. The women's line carries its own queen's emblem, and pieces for children can be requested as custom orders.

Standard sizes S to XXL, or made to measure. The how to measure guide at kobainkulture.pages.dev/measure.html shows the 10 measurements to take (chest, shoulders, sleeve, top length, neck, waist, hips, trouser length, inseam, head) and has a form that sends them straight to WhatsApp.
Royal Crest (power, heritage and legacy), Motorsport (racing kulture fused with African heritage) and Dark Masked (identity, mystery and power), plus traditional heritage wear and the women's line.
Patterns inspired by Akwete cloth from Abia State, Adinkra symbols and Kente cloth from Ghana, and Igbo motifs, redrawn in the Kobain Kulture style.

faqs.q: Are you on Instagram or TikTok?
faqs.a: Yes. Follow @kobainkulture on Instagram (instagram.com/kobainkulture) and TikTok (tiktok.com/@kobainkulture) for new pieces.

Amarachukwu Chikwekwem, known as Kobain, founded the brand in Umuahia North, Abia State, to preserve heritage and kulture. The safari photos of him with zebras, giraffes and lions show real pieces he designed and wears.

faqs.q: Where can I see more photos and films?
faqs.a: The Lookbook (kobainkulture.pages.dev/lookbook.html) shows styled looks, and The Archive (kobainkulture.pages.dev/archive.html) holds the founder's own photos, every collection design board and short films.

faqs.q: How long does a custom order take?
faqs.a: It depends on the piece and the design. The team gives you a timeline on WhatsApp when the design and price are agreed.
